name: Concealer / Color Corrector
description:
Need to hide those pesky blemishes or dark circles? Look no further! Our new concealer and color corrector makeup is here to save the day. ✨ Our lightweight formula seamlessly conceals any imperfections, leaving you with a natural-looking, radiant complexion. 🙌
Size
15cm/11cm/2cm
